text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Official talks between visiting King Hussein of Jordan and Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa to start on Wednesday; trade exchanges between Bahrain and Jordan were worth 20.1 million dinars in 1995.
- Electricity minister says Bahrain's projected 1997/1998 budget includes allocations needed to carry out vital power and water projects.
- Bahrain signs the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty.
